parsed.internal_thinking: ג'ימי just warned me they're coming after my ore strategy next turn. They've already moved the robber to hex 5 (B6) to block my O3 access at node 25. Now they're threatening to be 'sharper' next turn. This is a direct warning about aggressive play. But looking at the board: I have node 14 path secured with roads already in place. ג'ימי is at 2 VP, same as me. They have ore monopoly forming (nodes 12, 18 both O5, blocking O3). My backup is node 42 (O5). The real issue: I need B+W+S to build at node 14 next turn and reach 3 VP. ג'ימי has B1+W1+S2—they're the only viable trade partner. If I can trade with them tomorrow, I build at node 14 and pull ahead to 3 VP. If they refuse or block me, I'm stuck. Their threat is real but also a signal they see me as a threat. That's good—it means my node 14 play is working. I should stay calm, not overreact. Silence is stronger than bravado here. Let them wonder if I'm worried.
